props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Endpoint and user-operated compute technology domain.

props.name: technology-platform

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Endpoint identity attributes, posture measurements, and trust signals.

metadata.remarks:
Endpoint Identity and Posture defines the capability to uniquely identify endpoints and to evaluate trust signals describing their security‑relevant characteristics. Posture is treated as an input to identity‑, network‑, and policy‑based decisions and does not by itself guarantee trust.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance related to endpoint identity establishment, posture evaluation, and trust signaling. Enforcement and remediation are intentionally excluded to preserve clean architectural boundaries.

components.title: Endpoint Identity
components.description: Unique and verifiable identification of endpoint devices.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of trusted endpoint identities to gain unauthorized access.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Verification of endpoint identity prior to trust decisions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Assign and manage unique identifiers for endpoint devices.

components.title: Hardware and OS Characteristics
components.description: Collection of endpoint hardware and operating system attributes relevant to trust decisions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: System information discovery to tailor attacks to endpoint characteristics.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Authoritative inventory of endpoint hardware and operating system attributes.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Maintain accurate inventory information for endpoint hardware and operating systems.

components.title: Posture Signals
components.description: Evaluation of security‑relevant endpoint posture signals used to inform decisions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Impairment or falsification of endpoint posture signals.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Collection and evaluation of endpoint posture indicators.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Collect and evaluate endpoint security posture signals.

components.title: Trust Signaling
components.description: Secure presentation of endpoint identity and posture information to relying policy engines.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Credential or signal interception or tampering affecting trust decisions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Integrity‑protected and authenticated trust signal transport.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Use protected mechanisms to convey endpoint trust and posture assertions.
